problems.description: A findings-shaped payload inside the METADATA file. The real .descriptions.json carries no `problems` key, so this array is deliberately synthetic. It exists so that widening collect_intellij_issues' `"$IDEA_EDIR"/*.json` glob to also match leading-dot names becomes OBSERVABLE: without it, a run that read this file as a report and one that did not would produce the same issues[]. It is NOT here to guard a `.descriptions`-stem check — no such check exists, and the unreachable one that used to has been deleted.
